synthesis.trait: Needles John with mocking, personal insults framed as banter/hostility
Escalates to genuinely hostile, vulgar hostility when provoked

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Needles John with mocking, personal insults framed as banter/hostility
turning_points.what_changes: The first beat is a light jab about tardiness/rehab framed as welcome-back banter; here McAvoy responds to John's crude insult with a raw obscenity and open hostility ('Fuck you, Kierstead'), a clear escalation in vulgarity and personal animosity beyond the earlier teasing.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Escalates to genuinely hostile, vulgar hostility when provoked
turning_points.what_changes: The same escalating confrontation continues unbroken: McAvoy pushes further from a personal curse to actively wishing John relapses, raising the stakes from insult to weaponizing John's addiction/recovery against him.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Escalates to genuinely hostile, vulgar hostility when provoked
turning_points.what_changes: The same confrontation resolves in the same unbroken sequence: Sarge intervenes with authority, McAvoy is ordered out, mutters a final insult, and leaves -- the direct continuation and endpoint of the escalating exchange begun in the prior two beats.
